主要内容: On June 12, 2014, MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP stockholders ratified the appointment of WeiserMazars LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm with 22,345,674 votes for, 287,695 against, and 125,456 abstained. Additionally, stockholders approved a non-binding advisory resolution on executive compensation with 9,642,600 votes for, 2,898,853 against, 452,910 abstained, and 9,764,460 broker non-votes. The report was signed by Larry D. Hall, Chief Financial Officer, on June 12, 2014.
